collection.description: Two families disagree whether a funeral should use an ancient chant or a new melody.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two families disagree whether a funeral should use an ancient chant or a new melody.

choices.label: Ask the closest mourners to decide.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The familiar words comfort many mourners.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A younger relative feels the song did not reflect the deceased.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The family recognizes the deceased's favorite rhythm.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder feels a valued custom was overlooked.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The ceremony honors both memories and change.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The combined performance feels awkward to some.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Other relatives disagree but keep the peace.
